description:
Rewrite the storage-format reference and the concepts pages so they describe per-key gate runs, verdict records, archive evidence and lease records, and name the history files with the commands that read them.

## Background

`docs/reference/storage-format.md` describes gate runs as one directory per run, the claims control plane with a `claims.index.json` "derived cache" of `claims.jsonl`, and no history files or their readers. `docs/concepts/guarantees.md` lists the index in its layout, draws claim acquisition reading the index, states that issue operations read only the log's length and final line, and states the claim-parse failure. `docs/concepts/overview.md` shows the gate-run tree. `docs/reference/worktree-validate.md` states that whole-repository validation reads the event log for fidelity.

The storage after this epic: gate runs are `gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json`, the issue's gate state names its latest run in `run_id`, verdict records live at `gate-runs/verdicts/<gate-key>/<inputs-digest>.json`, archive evidence at `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, and leases at `.git/jit/leases/<issue-id>.json` with a `claims.seq` counter. The history files are the event log, the gate-run directories, the redo scratch directory (which can hold appended event bytes) and `claims.jsonl`. The history-reporting commands are `jit events`, `jit worktree store-divergence`, `jit gate status --all` and `--limit`, the server's gate-run list, whole-repository `jit validate` and the `repository_validation` checker. Those last two read the whole event log and every gate-run record for record fidelity. No command reads `claims.jsonl`, and nothing is derived from a history file. An unknown event tag and a malformed middle line are errors naming their line, and an unterminated final line is ignored.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `storage-format.md` describes each per-key record by path and states that it is written in the same redo record as the change that produces it. Its flat gate-run layout and every "derived cache" or index wording are gone.
- [hard] REQ-02: `storage-format.md` has a history-files section that names the event log, the gate-run directories, the redo scratch directory and `claims.jsonl`, with the commands that read each, and states that no other command reads one and no file is derived from one.
- [hard] REQ-03: `guarantees.md` and `overview.md` match the per-key layout, and the statement that issue operations read only the log's length and final line is true.
- [hard] REQ-04: `worktree-validate.md` names whole-repository validation as a history reader.
title: The storage-format reference describes per-key records and history files
